notes:
Inbound self-serve signup from indie dev duo building a tiny collaborative writing app (web + mobile). Signed up via quickstart template 'chat + embeddings' and created first API key 2026-02-25. Lightweight stack: Next.js frontend, Rust backend, using hosted API for generation + embeddings to power app search/assist.

Recent activity timeline:
- 2026-02-25: account created, API key generated, ran smoke tests (hello world prompts).
- 2026-02-26: first successful embed calls; developer reported 'fast and straightforward docs' via gmail thread thread-2193847.
- 2026-03-01: reached out to support about rate limits -> ticket RINF-1289 (answered, increased trial throttles temporarily).
- 2026-03-05: low-latency concern; measured median generation latency ~140-180ms for short chat; developer asks how to reduce token cost.
- 2026-03-09: usage spike (~35k tokens/day) when they seeding a closed beta; still within free credits but evaluating monthly cost.
- 2026-03-12: small follow-up: asked about embeddings bulk ingestion and best-practices for prefix caching. Fireflies snippet ff-20260301-4321 (10m) with dev-sent notes attached.

Use-case & requirements summary (from dev notes):
- Primary workload: chat assistant for creative writing (low context windows, many short messages), secondary: embeddings for doc search + reranking for suggestions. Also experimenting with code-assist snippets to generate small boilerplate for users.
- Targets: median response latency <200ms for short (<=128 token) replies; throughput is modest (initial beta 10-50 reqs/min).
- Cost sensitivity: high; founding duo on micro-budget — looking to keep hosted costs under $200-400/month at scale initially.
- Model preferences: prefers smaller/lighter models to trade quality for cost; open to quantized variants and caching suggestions.
- Routing/fallback: expects automatic fallback to cheaper model variant when credits low; no multi-region requirement at this stage.
- Security/compliance: basic audit logging preferred, no SSO or ISO/SOC push yet; data residency not a blocker.

Quotes / developer voice:
- "Docs were easy — had a demo up in 20 minutes."
- "Pricing is the single gating factor for us right now."

POC milestones & metrics the dev is watching:
- embed ingestion throughput (docs/min) and recall at 10
- cost per active user (target <$1/mo during beta)
- latency distribution for short chat flows (<200ms target)

Notes on engagement model:
- Pure PLG so far; no account exec outreach planned unless usage or spending thresholds hit. AE owner (Aisha Moreno) set in CRM for potential handoff if they request enterprise features. SE not assigned.

Suggested internal playbook notes:
- Watch usage daily for 2 weeks; if tokens >200k/month, offer 1-month discounted committed tier or onboarding credit.
- Share Redwood Optimize tips: batching, prefix caching and cheaper model fallbacks for long-running experiments.
- Provide short best-practices doc link (drive above) on embeddings bulk ingest and chunk sizing.
